==Usage==
===External links===
<code><nowiki>{{Facebook|username=|name=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

'''Required parameters'''
*{{Para|username}} Facebook nickname of author
*{{Para|name}} Author being cited in the linked post. Supports wikilinks.

'''Optional parameters'''
*Backup parameters; see below

===References===
<code><nowiki>{{Facebook|username=|url=|name=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

Required parameters
*{{Para|username}} Facebook nickname of author
*{{Para|url}} Permanent URL to Facebook wall post, excluding the <code>https://www.facebook.com/</code> portion.
*{{Para|name}} Author being cited in the linked post. Supports wikilinks.

'''Optional parameters'''
*{{Para|date}} Date the Facebook post was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} A short excerpt from the citation for quick reference in the article.
*{{Para|nolive}} Use <code>nolive=1</code> if the original content is no longer available.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Facebook|username=StarWars|name=[[Star Wars]]|archivedate=20111015160403}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Facebook|username=StarWars|name=[[Star Wars]]|archivedate=20111015160403}}

<hr />

<code><nowiki>{{Facebook|username=people/Mick-Cobb/803276493380209|url=803276493380209/photos/wow-found-out-this-morning-im-in-the-new-book-rise-of-skywalker-was-an-honour-to/993399211034602|name=[[Mick Cobb]]|date=2019-12-20|quote=Wow found out this morning I'm in the New book Rise of Skywalker was an honour to be part of the Star Wars family was great to work on it|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/1XGjH}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Facebook|username=people/Mick-Cobb/803276493380209|url=803276493380209/photos/wow-found-out-this-morning-im-in-the-new-book-rise-of-skywalker-was-an-honour-to/993399211034602|name=[[Mick Cobb]]|date=2019-12-20|quote=Wow found out this morning I'm in the New book Rise of Skywalker was an honour to be part of the Star Wars family was great to work on it|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/1XGjH}}
